integrity: Analytic first-exit and continuation proofs support the infinite-time claims; symbolic identities and finite numerical diagnostics are additional checks. Mathematical originality remains subject to unindexed equivalent literature. No independent audit is represented.
scientific_limitations: The real ODE is classified for forward completeness as a vector field, not by the fate of every orbit. Positive and zero cubic feedback have open finite-time escape sets, but basins of bounded attractors, global asymptotic boundedness under negative feedback, and hardware dynamics are not classified.
title: Sharp forward-completeness threshold and two escape clocks in a cubic jerk flow
